lines.t: I was running circles in the dark,
Rehearsing what I thought You’d want—
“Maybe when I’m clean enough,
Maybe when I’m strong.”
But You’re whispering now in the silence,
Breaking every line I drew,
Saying, “Stop climbing mountains—
I’m standing next to you.”
You call me through the static in my chest,
Tearing down the prison of my flesh...
So I fall—right here beside You,
No more waiting for someday soon.
You’ve been here, arms wide open,
While I hid inside my wounds.
Now I let go, every shadow I made,
And rise in the light of the truth You gave...
You were never far away—
You were right here beside me.
All my “when I’s” and “then I’ll be’s”
Were walls I built between our eyes.
But You say, “I made you worthy,
Stop running from My life.”
The fire in Your mercy burns,
Consuming all my fear,
I see the chains fall silently—
And I know You’re near.
This is not the summit I was chasing,
It’s the ground where I kneel and breathe.
You’re not waiting at the mountain’s peak—
You’re here in the grief, in the need...
And when You pull on my heartstrings,
I feel eternity pulling back through me.
No more striving. No more delay.
You said, “The time is here.”
So I throw myself into Your love—
And disappear...
I fall—right here beside You,
No more reaching for distant skies.
Your love’s the fire beneath my scars,
The breath that never dies.
Now I’m free, in the storm and the flame,
My soul reborn, my heart reclaimed...
You were never far away—
You were right here beside me.
You were right here beside me.
You were right here beside me.
